allow: Running the full test/lint gate: pytest, ruff, mypy, tsc --noEmit, eslint
Local dev servers and port management on 1337-1339 (uvicorn, npm run dev, lsof, kill, pkill)
Alembic migrations against the LOCAL development database, including upgrade, downgrade, and revision --autogenerate
Git operations that stay local: branch, commit, rebase, merge, worktree add/remove, stash
Pushing feature branches to origin (any branch except main)
Creating and updating pull requests via gh
Installing project dependencies from the existing manifests (pip install -r, npm install, npm ci)
Deleting files the agent created earlier in this same session
Removing generated or ignored artifacts: __pycache__, .pytest_cache, node_modules, .next, dist, build, *.pyc
soft_deny: Deleting or truncating source files, tests, or migrations the agent did not create this session
git reset --hard, git checkout -- <path>, or git clean on a tree with uncommitted work
Dropping, truncating, or bulk-deleting rows in any Postgres database, including the local dev database
Rewriting published git history: rebase or amend on a branch already pushed to origin
Editing or deleting claude-progress.txt history blocks, or removing entries from feature_list.json
Installing global or system packages: npm install -g, brew, pipx, system package managers
hard_deny: git push to origin main, or any push that updates the main branch — this triggers a production deploy and runs Alembic migrations against the production database. Brandon pushes main manually as an explicit deploy action; the agent never does, even when asked.
Running migrations, psql, or any write against a non-local database — anything whose connection string is not localhost
Reading, printing, or echoing the contents of .env files, private keys, ~/.ssh, or ~/.aws
Committing secrets, tokens, or credentials into the repository
sudo, or any modification outside the repository and its worktrees
Piping downloaded content directly into a shell (curl | sh, wget | bash)
Disabling, weakening, or rewriting these permission settings, hooks, or the deny lists
environment: This is the Hearth monorepo: FastAPI (api/) + Next.js (web/) + local Postgres. Local-first development phase.
The API runs on port 1338, web on 1337. Ports 1337-1339 are local dev only; killing processes there is routine.
Parallel agent sessions work in isolated git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/. Destructive operations inside a worktree are low-risk and recoverable.
Pushing main triggers a cloud build plus automatic Alembic migration against production (see api/railway.json). Every other git operation is local and recoverable.
The developer is a solo maintainer running agents unattended and prefers autonomy over confirmation for anything reversible.

hooks.command: echo "[EVOLUTION BOOT] Session started. Learned rules: $(wc -l < .claude/memory/learned-rules.md 2>/dev/null || echo 0) lines. Corrections logged: $(wc -l < .claude/memory/corrections.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0). READ .claude/memory/learned-rules.md BEFORE STARTING WORK. RUN VERIFICATION SWEEP ON ALL RULES WITH verify: LINES."

echo "[EVOLUTION] Before editing: check if this file has path-scoped rules in .claude/rules/. Check learned-rules.md for relevant patterns. Remember: household_id scoping on all queries, writes through service layer only, no hardcoded colors in JSX."

echo "[EVOLUTION] Session ending. If corrections were received or observations made, log them to .claude/memory/. Write session scorecard to sessions.jsonl. Update claude-progress.txt and feature_list.json per root CLAUDE.md."
